subject: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@skyforge.com>, Ida Svensson <ida@skyforge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration

Hi Michael / Ida —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a first pass MAP that breaks the onboarding into discrete milestones, proposed dates, and owner assignments so we can align expectations and commit to a go-live window. High-level asks from our side: confirmation of implementation owners, any blackout dates for onboarding (holiday or release freezes), and legal/PO timing.

Key milestones in the spreadsheet (attached):
- Kickoff & environment access (credentials + test dataset) — target Apr 19 — owner: SkyForge IT
- Model selection & baseline testing — target Apr 26 — owner: Redwood eng (Karthik) + SkyForge data
- Integration & feature flag rollout — target May 10 — owner: SkyForge eng + Lauren for SDK support
- Performance tuning & QA — target May 24 — owner: Redwood infra (Monica)
- Final acceptance & go-live — target Jun 1 — owner: joint

Please review the attached MAP (SkyForge_MAP_v1.xlsx) and reply with any date conflicts or owner changes by EOD Wed Apr 7 so we can lock it and start scheduling working sessions. If you'd prefer a compressed schedule, flag which milestones you want to accelerate and we’ll propose resourcing tradeoffs.

Attachments: [SkyForge_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]

Next steps:
- Michael / Ida: confirm owners + blackout windows (by 2027-04-07)
- Redwood: internal resourcing check and SOW draft to follow (ETA 2027-04-07)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Michael Turner <m.turner@skyforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
Cc: Ida Svensson <ida@skyforge.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration

On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 9:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example> wrote:
> Hi Michael / Ida —
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a first pass MAP that breaks the onboarding into discrete milestones...

Marcus — thanks for the clear breakdown. Overall this looks good. Quick notes from our side:
- We can meet the Apr 19 kickoff but need the credentials by Apr 16 (security review window).
- The May 10 integration milestone needs to shift one week later — our API team has a planned release on May 3 that blocks major infra changes until May 12.
- Procurement asked we identify the SOW reviewer (we use procurement@skyforge.com) and that PO timing is aligned before final acceptance.

I'll loop procurement separately and confirm owners today. Attaching a short internal checklist we use for access (no sensitive material, just steps).

Thanks — I'll confirm owners by EOD.

Best,
Michael Turner
Head of Product Integrations, SkyForge Inc.
m.turner@skyforge.com
[Attachment: SkyForge_access_checklist.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@skyforge.com>, Ida Svensson <ida@skyforge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration

Thanks Michael — good catch on the May 3 release window. I've updated the MAP to shift the integration & feature flag milestone one week later to May 17 and adjusted downstream dates accordingly; updated file attached as SkyForge_MAP_v1.xlsx (versioned).

Re: credentials: we’ll plan for Redwood to receive environment access no later than Apr 16. Karthik — can you confirm the Redwood baseline testing slot Apr 26 works if we receive the data by Apr 16?

Monica — we’ll need your team to reserve a 2-day tuning window starting May 24 and a fallback rollback plan in the runbook. Lauren — can you own the SDK install session with SkyForge eng the week of May 17?

Procurement note: Michael, once procurement confirms SOW reviewer and PO cadence please share contact and expected approval lead time (we'll prepare the DocuSign/SOW link).

Attachments: [SkyForge_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 33KB)]

—Marcus

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration

Marcus / team — quick internal sync:

- Apr 26 baseline testing slot: Confirmed, pending we have a sanitized test slice by Apr 16. I'll coordinate with our infra to reserve compute and start the perf harness.
- May 17 integration: I can take the first two days of integration testing; Lauren will lead the SDK/hand-off session on May 18.
- Tuning window May 24-25: Monica, please confirm you have a 2-day block reserved (we may need to extend to 3 days depending on tokenization edge cases).

I also attached a draft SOW that captures deliverables and acceptance criteria. It needs legal and procurement review; there are a couple of TBDs around data retention and encryption-at-rest language.

Attachments: [SOW_SkyForge_Redwood_draft.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Technical Program Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Ida Svensson <ida@skyforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example>
Cc: Michael Turner <m.turner@skyforge.com>, procurement@skyforge.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration

Thanks all — procurement@skyforge.com will be the SOW reviewer; expected internal review window is 7–10 business days. We can commit to the updated dates (kickoff Apr 19 with credentials by Apr 16).

A couple of asks from SkyForge:
- Please share Redwood's SOC2 artefacts or a link to hosted evidence (we need to attach this to our procurement packet).
- Can the SOW include a clause for a one-week grace period after go-live for bug fixes?

We are OK with the May 17 integration date. Procurement will reach out if legal redlines are needed.

—Ida
Ida Svensson
Director, IT Integrations, SkyForge Inc.
ida@skyforge.com

Subject: Re: Activation roadmap & owner commitments for Redwood integration

All —

Thanks — confirming items and next steps. I've attached the consolidated MAP and a short SOC2 evidence pointer file (links to our compliance portal). Summary below and deliverable links: 

Consolidated milestones (finalized):
- Apr 16: Credentials & test data delivered (SkyForge IT)
- Apr 19: Project kickoff call (joint)
- Apr 26: Baseline model selection & tests (Redwood/Karthik)
- May 17: Integration & SDK session (Lauren + SkyForge eng)
- May 24–26: Performance tuning & QA (Monica)
- Jun 1: Final acceptance & go-live (joint)

Deliverables shared:
- MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-SkyForge-Onboarding (SkyForge_MAP_v1.xlsx)
- SOW draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B-SOW_SkyForge_Redwood_draft.pdf
- SOC2 evidence links: [SOC2-Redwood-evidence-links.txt] (contains compliance portal URLs)

Action items:
- SkyForge (Michael / Ida): share procurement contact timeline if it slips outside the 7–10 business day window (procurement@skyforge.com is in cc).
- Redwood: prepare DocuSign SOW link and version the SOW with the one-week post-go-live bug-fix clause (Karthik + Legal). Target to send SOW for signature by Apr 12.
- All: Confirm kickoff calendar invite (Marcus to send after credentials are available).

If there are no objections, I’ll mark the MAP as final and begin calendaring the working sessions.

Attachments: [SkyForge_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 33KB), SOC2-Redwood-evidence-links.txt (txt, 1KB), SOW_SkyForge_Redwood_draft.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]
